spots.name: University City of Caracas
spots.summary: The University City of Caracas, also known by the acronym CUC, is the main campus of the Central University of Venezuela (UCV), located in central Caracas, the capital of Venezuela. It was designed by the Venezuelan architect Carlos Raúl Villanueva and was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 2000.

spots.name: Miraflores Palace
spots.summary: The Miraflores Palace is the official dispatch and head office of the president of Venezuela. It is located on Urdaneta Avenue, Libertador Bolivarian Municipality in Caracas.

spots.name: Palacio Federal Legislativo

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Palacio Federal Legislativo, also known as the Capitolio, is a historic building in Caracas, Venezuela, which houses the National Assembly. Located southwest of the Plaza Bolívar, it was built between 1872 and 1877 by President Antonio Guzmán Blanco to a design by the architect Luciano Urdaneta Vargas.

spots.name: Caracas Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Caracas Cathedral or Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Anne is the seat of the Roman Catholic Metropolitan archdiocese of Caracas, located on the Plaza Bolívar in Caracas, Venezuela. Its chapel of the Holy Trinity is the burial site of the parents and wife of Simón Bolívar.

spots.name: Bolívar Square
spots.summary: Bolívar Square in Caracas is one of the most important and recognized Venezuelan public spaces. It is located in the center of the first 25 blocks of Caracas when it was founded as "Santiago de León de Caracas" in 1567. It is in the historic center of the city in the Cathedral Parish of the Libertador Municipality.

spots.name: Parque del Este
spots.summary: The Parque del Este, renamed officially as Generalissimo Francisco de Miranda Park by President Hugo Chávez in honor of the Venezuelan national hero, is a public recreation park located in the Sucre Municipality of Metropolitan Caracas, Venezuela.

names.ja: フランシスコ・デ・ミランダ大元帥公園

spots.name: Teresa Carreño Cultural Complex
spots.summary: The Teresa Carreño Cultural Complex, also known as Teresa Carreño Theatre, is the most important theatre of Caracas and Venezuela, where performances include symphonic and popular concerts, opera, ballet and plays.

names.zh: 特雷莎·卡雷尼奧文化中心

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: Caracas Museum of Contemporary Art Armando Reverón, also known simply as the Caracas Museum of Contemporary Art, is a museum of modern and contemporary art located in the Parque Central Complex in Caracas, Venezuela.

spots.name: Plaza Francia
spots.summary: France Square, also known as "Plaza Altamira", is a public space located in Altamira, east Caracas. It was built at the beginning of the 1940s and opened on August 11, 1945, with the original name of "Plaza Altamira".

spots.name: Museo de Bellas Artes
spots.summary: The Museum of Fine Arts is an art museum in Caracas, Venezuela. It was founded in 1917, and was originally housed in the building now known as the Palacio de las Academias.

spots.name: Berger des Nuages
spots.summary: Berger des Nuages, Pastor de Nubes, or Cloud Shepherd is a work of art by Jean Arp just outside the Plaza Cubierta of the University City of Caracas.

spots.name: Bolivarian Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Bolivarian Museum is dedicated to Simón Bolívar, the hero of Latin American independence. It is situated in Caracas, Venezuela. The museum is run in tandem with the birthplace of Simón Bolívar next door. The collections include items related to Bolivar and Venezuelan independence.

spots.name: Aula Magna
spots.summary: The Aula Magna is an auditorium at the Central University of Venezuela. It is located within the University City of Caracas, next to the University's main library building.

spots.name: Teatro Municipal of Caracas
spots.summary: The Teatro Municipal of Caracas is an opera house in Venezuela. It was inaugurated by President Guzmán Blanco in 1881. The theatre was initially named after the president.

spots.name: Basilica of St. Teresa

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Basilica of St. Teresa It is one of the most important Catholic churches in Caracas, capital of Venezuela. It is the main center of veneration of the image of the Nazarene in San Pablo Easter, is located on the corner of La Palma and Santa Teresa in the city center in Santa Teresa Parish of Libertador Municipality.

spots.name: Palacio de las Academias

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Palacio de las Academias is a Neo-Gothic building on the Avenida Universidad in the centre of Caracas, Venezuela. It dates back to 1684 when a Franciscan convent was built on the site but in the 19th century it served as a barracks, a hospital and a college.

spots.name: Yellow House
spots.summary: The Casa Amarilla de Caracas is a 19th Century neoclassical building in Plaza Bolívar, Caracas and in front of the Santa Ana Cathedral, in the city's main historic quarter.

spots.name: Palacio Municipal de Caracas

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Palacio Municipal de Caracas, or Consejo Municipal de Caracas, is the city hall of Caracas, Venezuela. It is located on the corner of Gradillas a Monjas opposite the Plaza Bolívar, occupying half of the plaza's southern section.

spots.name: Basilica of Santa Capilla

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Basilica of Santa Capilla It is a Roman Catholic basilica in Caracas, Venezuela located at the corner of Santa Capilla on Avenida Urdaneta. It is located in the historic center of the city, in the Cathedral Parish of Libertador Municipality. On February 16, 1979 was declared a National Historic Landmark.

spots.name: L'Amphion
spots.summary: L'Amphion is a work of art by French sculptor and illustrator Henri Laurens, located in the Plaza Cubierta of the University City of Caracas. It is described as his "most famous sculpture". The shape is based on Amphion, a lyre-playing hero from Greek mythology.

spots.name: Clock Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The UCV Clock Tower, also known by its Spanish name Torre del Reloj de la UCV, or Reloj de la UCV, is a monument made of prestressed concrete. It is by the Rectory Plaza of the Central University of Venezuela in the University City of Caracas, and was built between 1953 and 1954.

names.es: Torre del Reloj de la UCV

spots.name: Olympic Stadium
spots.summary: Estadio Olímpico de la UCV is a multipurpose stadium used mainly for association football in Caracas, Venezuela, which serves the home ground of Caracas F.C., Deportivo La Guaira, Metropolitanos F.C., and Universidad Central. It has a capacity of 24,264.

spots.name: Caracas Athenaeum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Caracas Athenaeum is a cultural institution centred on the arts. It is currently located in Macaracuay, at the Southeast corner of Caracas, after having been expelled by the Bolivarian government from its premises located in the area of Los Caobos, Caracas, Venezuela.

spots.name: Teatro Simón Bolívar
spots.summary: The Teatro Simón Bolívar is a cultural and theatre complex located in the Libertador Municipality of Caracas. It is in the Rialto building near the Yellow House, the La Francia building, and Plaza Bolívar.

spots.name: Central Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Biblioteca Central de la UCV, or Central Library is the main library in the University City of Caracas, and the most important one of the Central University of Venezuela. It is easily accessible from anywhere in the city as it is near the Caracas Metro line 3 station Ciudad Universitaria.

spots.name: El Maní Es Así

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Located in a side street behind Sabana Grande, this remains Caracas' best-renowned salsa club where lower middle-class locals and tourists like to show off their moves, accompanied by live bands, till the early hours. To get a table, you'll probably have to pay 'servicio', i.e. agree to buy a bottle of rum or whisky. Sadly, the area around the club is not safe. Be careful at midnight.

spots.name: Heladeria La Poma

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The most popular ice cream shop in Caracas. People always stand in line, but these ice cream cones are not cheap. The boulevard has many ice cream shops in the nearby area, but La Poma is the only one that makes them crazy. A life waiting in line and no one understands why. Their products are not subsidized.

spots.name: Sal Si Puedes

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of the few genuinely bohemian spots still alive in Caracas, with great décor and a wonderfully eclectic crowd — university professors, writers, artists, poets, and assorted others all sharing the same space. Drinks are on the expensive side. As with most of the area, exercise caution after midnight.

spots.name: El León

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This Caracas stalwart benefits from one of the best open air terraces in Caracas. Plastic tables and chairs are simple and the service is slow, but the beers are cheap and the atmosphere is good. This is a favorite hangout for Caracas' college crowd. Be careful at midnight.

spots.name: Moulin Rouge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: It has two main areas: one for rock lovers and one for lovers of salsa and reggae. Great for alternative couples. BDSM games for couples and beginners. A place that really defies taboos. Be careful at midnight and arrange a taxi.

spots.name: Hog Heaven

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: More expensive than Los Peruanos, but cheaper than Sal Si Puedes. Incredible atmosphere. One of the best places for metalheads in Caracas. Nice drinks. Highly recommended. Be careful at midnight.

spots.name: La Huerta

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of the best Spanish restaurants in Caracas with a very rich history. It never disappoints. Once the favorite restaurant of the former president of Venezuela Carlos Andrés Pérez.

spots.name: El Rey Del Sujuk

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: New place in Sabana Grande. Nice shawarmas. Try Sujuk, one of the world’s most delicious and ancient types of sausage. The staff is really friendly. Highly recommended

spots.name: Pizzeria Va Bene

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Great modern decorn. Excellent menu. The best pizzas of Caracas. Take a selfie with Shakira, Gandhi and Carolina Herrera. Highly recommended.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Chinese restaurant in Caracas. Insanely big portions and great quality. Recommended. This is one of the best hidden gems of Sabana Grande
